_about: Official findings on named flood-control projects, matched to contract IDs. Built from research/R6_project_data.md (26 Oct 2026). 'match' says how sure the contract-ID match is: exact = cost to the centavo; strong = contractor + barangay + cost; candidate = plausible, other contracts could fit. 'expected' lists the Atlas outcomes that match the official finding (built_late was added when that outcome was introduced, for the 'not built when declared' finding only). Atlas never sees this file while it audits; it is read only by the evaluation.
